# mistershell_sensor (Resource)

Manages a MisterShell sensor.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_sensor" "example" {
  name        = "site-sensor"
  description = "Sensor registration; deploy the returned token separately."
  location_id = var.location_id
  is_enabled  = false
  config      = { interfaces = ["eth0"], home_net = ["192.0.2.0/24"] }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (Dynamic) Config. Accepts a native Terraform value.
- `location_id` (Number) Location ID (required)
- `name` (String) Name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Is enabled.

### Read-Only

- `applied_config_version` (String) Applied config version.
- `applied_ruleset_version` (String) Applied ruleset version.
- `config_version` (String) Config version.
- `connected_at` (String) Connected at.
- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `id` (String) Object identity. Import using this ID; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `last_heartbeat_at` (String) Last heartbeat at.
- `location` (Dynamic) Location. Accepts a native Terraform value.
- `mode` (String) Mode.
- `status` (String) Status.
- `suricata_version` (String) Suricata version.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Sensor authentication token. Shown only once at creation. Store it securely.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.
- `version` (String) Version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mistershell_sensor.example 123
```
